geometries.method: Editorial offshore point near the 18°N Mauritanian upwelling region studied in seasonal current observations; not a year-round core or length endpoint.
geometries.positional_uncertainty: not quantified; no observed current core or path

length_assessments.illustration_limit: Drawn map-arrow span, not a physical current length or lower bound
length_assessments.scope: The source reports poleward surface flow during the May–July relaxation season in the Mauritanian upwelling region; winter upwelling-season coastal flow is equatorward. A single year-round direction or whole-current length would misrepresent this seasonal regime.
